note.title: Identity and relationships with others
note.specFocus: Describing yourself and others, family and friendship, blended families, arguments and making up.
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style Mandarin Chinese themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
1.1 Identity and relationships with others
Key vocabulary (Simplified Chinese = pinyin = English)
- 家庭 jiātíng — family
- 父母 fùmǔ — parents
- 继父 jìfù — stepfather
- 外貌 wàimào — appearance
- 性格 xìnggé — personality
- 相处 xiāngchǔ — to get along
- 吵架 chǎojià — to argue
- 支持 zhīchí — to support

Key grammar
- Use 的 for descriptions and relationships; use 很 for a predicate adjective (她很友好, not *她友好*) where needed.
- Use 了 for a completed past event, 过 for an experienced action, and 在/正在 for an action in progress.
- Time normally goes before the action: 我上周/昨天 + verb; place goes before the main verb when giving a sequence of actions.
- Give reasons with 因为……所以…… and contrast with 虽然……但是……; use 如果……就…… for real conditions.
- Measure words matter: 四口人, 两个朋友, 一本书, 一所学校; use 比 for comparison and 最 for the superlative.

Exam tips
- Include an opinion and a reason; a bare adjective earns less communication than 因为……所以…… .
- Check measure words, negatives (不/没有), and time expressions before answering.
- Natural repetition is fine: accurate familiar vocabulary is better than a guessed rare word.

questions.modelAnswer: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
questions.question:
Translate into Mandarin Chinese:

There are four people in my family: Dad, Mum, my older sister and me.

questions.examTip: Choose a natural Chinese word order and check the correct measure word, time expression and negative.
questions.modelAnswer: 我和妈妈相处得很好，因为她总是鼓励我。
questions.question:
Translate into Mandarin Chinese:

I get on very well with my mum because she always encourages me.

questions.examTip: Choose a natural Chinese word order and check the correct measure word, time expression and negative.
questions.modelAnswer: 哥哥很幽默，但是有时候不听我的话。
questions.question:
Translate into Mandarin Chinese:

My older brother is funny, but sometimes he does not listen to me.

questions.examTip: Choose a natural Chinese word order and check the correct measure word, time expression and negative.

questions.question:
Translate into Mandarin Chinese:

My best friend is honest and very reliable.

questions.examTip: Choose a natural Chinese word order and check the correct measure word, time expression and negative.
questions.modelAnswer: 上个月我跟朋友吵架了，不过后来我们和好了。
questions.question:
Translate into Mandarin Chinese:

Last month I argued with a friend, but later we made up.

questions.examTip: Choose a natural Chinese word order and check the correct measure word, time expression and negative.
questions.modelAnswer: 我现在和继母住在一起，她对我很好。
questions.question:
Translate into Mandarin Chinese:

I now live with my stepmother, who is kind to me.

questions.examTip: Plan one or two accurate sentences per bullet and include at least a past event, an opinion with a reason, and a future plan.
questions.modelAnswer:
我的表弟个子高，留着短黑发。 我觉得好朋友应该互相尊重。 虽然妹妹有时很烦人，我还是喜欢和她聊天。 我觉得这个话题很重要，因为和我们的日常生活有关。如果有机会，我以后会继续了解。

(English translation: My male cousin is tall and has short black hair. I think good friends should respect one another. Although my younger sister is sometimes annoying, I still enjoy chatting with her. I think this topic is important because it is related to our daily lives. If I have the chance, I will continue to learn about it in the future.)
questions.question:
Write in Mandarin Chinese about identity and relationships with others. You must mention:
• Describe the cousin’s appearance.
• what happened in the past
• an opinion with a reason
• your plan or a future possibility

If I have the chance, I will continue to learn about it in the future.)
